sources.label: Patches for morphe
sources.author: Hooman
patch_list: Removes the ads in Advanced Download Manager. ADM's paid state is the ad-free RevenueCat entitlement cached on the device, so the app also labels itself Pro.

sources.label: Morphe patches for ADM (com.dv.adm): ad suppression, rating prompt removal, and
sources.author: Oyasumi
patch_list: Skip ADM's Appodeal and AppBrain ad setup and display routines, and the Telegram join prompt.
Skip ADM's automatic rating prompt. The menu item that opens the same dialog on request is left intact.
Raise the download ceilings to 32 simultaneous downloads and 64 connections per download, and set torrent defaults to 500 global and 100 per torrent.
